[!] THE SELECTION METHOD, because 'seems like a good fit' is how the wrong work lands on the wrong model. Pick the first class by ONE property: its output must be CHEAPLY VERIFIABLE against ground truth that already exists, so a bad fit is caught on the first run instead of propagating into a register. Run it on inputs a current-model lane has ALREADY done, diff the outputs, and widen only on that evidence. State the population of any quality claim, per RULE ONE. [!] WHAT THIS ROW MAY NOT DO, and it is the one hard edge: budget headroom is NEVER a reason to move work off the model its risk demands. .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md already binds 'anything on a real-money order path' to opus. No claim about Fable's fit for any lane in this repo has been made or tested as of 2026-09-21 -- the only established facts are that the pool exists, is separate, and is unused. Do not read a task list into this row that is not here. [!] FIRST FABLE ROUTING DECIDED AND DISPATCHED 2026-09-21, and the class chosen is GREP-AND-CLASSIFY SWEEP OVER A REPOSITORY.
